ranking_rule: lexicographic: minimum raw/specific positive rate, summed positive rates, minimum projection mean, summed means, split-half cosine, then shallower layer
interpretation_limit: Exploratory gradient generalization is not causal steering, ablation, or proof of a naturally active self-preservation mechanism.
selection_caveats: The ranking selects among many layers using only the validation cases, so the winning layer has winner's-curse risk.
Raw gradient projection magnitudes are not calibrated intervention effects and should not be compared as a common strength scale across layers.
Split-half stability is descriptive and is based on only one deterministic split.
